articleTitle: Study on power prediction of photovoltaic power generation based on NGO-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Forecasting photovoltaic (PV) power is crucial for addressing climate change and supporting the energy transition. Although PV generation produces no carbon emissions, its output varies due to environmental factors, complicating accurate predictions. PV power forecasts are divided in to ultra-short-term, short-term, and medium-to long-term categories, with this study focusing specifically on ultra-short-term predictions. The approaches used include physics-based methods, statistical techniques, artificial intelligence, and hybrid strategies. Particularly, combining deep learning with swarm intelligence algorithms can enhance accuracy. This paper presents the NGO-LSTM model to improve PV power forecasting and assist with power system scheduling.

articleTitle: Research on high precision real-time digital twin model
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the development of digital twin technology, high-precision digital twin technology is becoming increasingly urgent in production practice. This article proposes a high-precision digital twin model construction method for electromechanical actuators based on practical production needs. Firstly, a twin mechanism model was constructed from the aspects of geometry, physics, behavior, and rules. The time-varying transfer function of the electromechanical actuator was established, and the parameters were identified and updated through particle swarm optimization to achieve digital mapping. Secondly, a twin data model was constructed, taking historical data of relevant features as input, and a BP neural network-based input voltage prediction model was constructed. Finally, the accuracy and feasibility of the twin mechanism model were verified through simulation, and the introduced digital twin technology provides a new method for real-time interaction and adjustment between the theoretical model of electromechanical actuators and actual data.

articleTitle: Optimization of Task Scheduling Strategy for UAV-enabled Cloud-edge Collaboration System using Reinforcement Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Transmission line inspections have increasingly adopted UAVs equipped with multiple sensors to collect data during inspection processes. However, the limited computational capabilities of UAVs make processing multiple data types simultaneously challenging, often leading to high processing latency. To address this issue, this paper proposes an optimized UAV task scheduling strategy based on cloud-edge collaboration. The proposed strategy utilizes reinforcement learning to enable dynamic offloading of computational tasks to edge servers and cloud servers, thereby reducing task execution time and enhancing overall inspection efficiency. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in minimizing processing latency and improving the reliability of transmission line inspections.

articleTitle: Analyzing Frequency Characteristics: The Role of Traditional and Virtual Inertia in Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The widespread application of wind and solar energy has led to a significant integration of power electronic devices into the power system, resulting in a reduced level of system inertia. Consequently, the frequency stability of power systems has garnered extensive attention in both academia and industry. Currently, virtual inertia is widely utilized in the control of inverters to compensate for the lack of system inertia. To compare the frequency stability of power systems with virtual inertia against traditional power systems, it is necessary to establish models for simulation analysis. This paper establishes single-machine infinite models for both the synchronous generator and the Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG), ensuring that the basic parameters of the two models are the same. Taking into account the stiffer external characteristics and control strategies of the inverter, virtual impedance technology is incorporated to smooth the control process. The frequency waveforms obtained from the MATLAB/Simulink simulation model validate the consistency of the frequency characteristics between traditional inertia and virtual inertia.

articleTitle: An Approach to Forecasting Short-Term Photovoltaic Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: As photovoltaic power generation technology matures, an increasing number of distributed photovoltaics are being integrated into the distribution network. Due to the inherent randomness and intermittency of their output, this integration poses a series of challenges for grid-connected distribution systems. One effective approach to mitigate these adverse effects is through accurate forecasting of photovoltaic power generation, which can alleviate impacts on the grid and enhance power quality. This paper proposes a PV power prediction model that leverages the K-Means ++ algorithm, an improved similar day method, and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) networks.

articleTitle: Health Assessment Method for Trapezoidal Screw Pairs Based on Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Once the trapezoidal lead screw in the radar antenna lifting mechanism fails, it is likely to cause personnel and equipment safety accidents. This article proposes a transfer learning based trapezoidal lead screw health discrimination method to address the problem of the lack of effective discrimination of the health of trapezoidal lead screw pairs. By collecting trapezoidal lead screw vibration data in a healthy state and transferring the vibration signal characteristics learned from public gear datasets, the trapezoidal lead screw vibration data is fitted to construct a trapezoidal lead screw health index. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper can effectively monitor the abnormal state of trapezoidal screw and has a significant effect on preventing screw failure.

articleTitle: A Current Signal Compression Acquisition and Reconstruction Method Considering Fault Arc Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Aiming at the challenge of high frequency arc fault signal acquisition, a current signal compression acquisition and reconstruction approach taking into account arc-fault identification is proposed for the low-body-volume acquisition of arc-fault signals, which effectively preserves the high-frequency arc-fault characteristics in the current data. Firstly, the current signals characterizing the fault arcs are collected using a flexible Blackman window for sliding acquisition. Then, it employs an improved partially orthogonal Gaussian measurement matrix to achieve compressed acquisition of the current signals through Compressed Sensing (CS) technology. Subsequently, the collected current signals undergo sparse transformation using Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT). Finally, the method utilizes the Compressive Sampling Matching Pursuit based on Optimal Sparsity Estimation (CSMP-OSE) to achieve accurate iterative reconstruction of the compressed high-frequency arc low-dimensional data. Experimental validation based on the substation arc fault dataset demonstrates that this method offers robust arc fault characterization capability, high reconstruction accuracy, and efficiency.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimization of Interior Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Grey Wolf Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: To enhance the operational performance of a certain interior permanent magnet synchronous motor, a multi-objective optimization design method based on the Response Surface Method (RSM) and Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO) algorithm is proposed. The permanent magnet thickness, width, and air gap length are selected as optimization parameters, with the torque, torque ripple, and cogging torque of a 30 kW permanent magnet synchronous motor as the optimization objectives. The fitting relationship and quadratic polynomial regression model between the optimization parameters and objectives are obtained through the Response Surface Method. The Grey Wolf Optimizer is then utilized for optimization. Finally, a comparison of the motor performance before and after optimization shows that the torque has increased by 6.15%, the torque ripple has decreased by $\mathbf{3 7. 5 1 \%}$, and the cogging torque has decreased by 19.75%.

articleTitle: Knowledge Graph based Quality Supervision Question-and-Answer System for Offshore Oil Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the developments of offshore oil industry, a large number of specification documents have been implemented in the field of offshore oil engineering quality, which has placed significant posed pressure and a series of challenges to the traditional manual inspection method of engineering quality. This paper uses entity relationship recognition, data extraction and graph database technologies to construct a quality knowledge graph for offshore oil engineering. Subsequently, a quality supervision question-and-answer (Q&A) system for offshore oil engineering is developed based on this knowledge graph. The system has functional modules including quality inspection Q&A and problem case retrieval, enabling intelligent Q&A for quality inspection. This not only enhances the standardization and work efficiency of quality inspection but also elevates the intelligence level of quality supervision operations in offshore oil engineering projects.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Generalized Proportional Integral Observer Based Active Disturbance Rejection Control for Coarse Pointing Assembly
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The coarse pointing assembly (CPA), as the outer loop of the laser terminal, its tracking stability is the basis for ensuring laser communication. This paper presents the model of the CPA. Aiming at the disturbance factors in the low-speed operation process of the CPA, an active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) method for the position loop of the CPA is designed based on the generalized proportional integral observer (GPIO) to achieve disturbance compensation control. Finally, simulations are carried out on the system model. The simulation results show that compared with the PID control strategy adopted, the proposed ADRC strategy based on GPIO of the CPA can effectively improve the tracking accuracy.

articleTitle: Motion analysis of a Quadruped Softrobot based on Magnetic Actuation
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In this study, we present a novel programmable quadrupedal soft robot, designed with the concept of two distinct symmetric directions of magnetization. This soft robot utilizes a magnetic drive system that enables precise motion control and facilitates stable crawling motion under the influence of a magnetic field. Experimental results indicate that the symmetric magnetization configuration, characterized by two pairs of feet oriented in opposing directions, effectively achieves quadrupedal alternating motion. Under these conditions, the soft robot demonstrates a consistent average speed of 4.5 mm/s when subjected to a Z-axis magnetic field strength of 85 GS and a frequency of 15 Hz. This performance is substantially superior when compared to a control configuration with identical symmetric orientation of the two pairs of feet, which yields a lower speed of 2.1 mm/s. Our comprehensive movement tests across various control modes further illustrate the soft robot’s robust locomotor capabilities, underscoring its potential applicability in fields such as biomedicine, emergency rescue, and environmental monitoring.

articleTitle: Research on the Selection of Intermediate Connection Points for Active Emergency Steering Path Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The two-segment polynomial path planning method can avoid collisions by steering under lower Time to Collision (TTC) conditions. The intermediate connection point is an unknown and critical constraint for calculating the analytical solutions of the two polynomial paths, whose position is determined based on the principle of not collision and being closest to obstacles. When encountering emergency scenarios where there is an angle between obstacles and the road, the traditional method of determining the intermediate connection point will become ineffective, as four potential collision risks involving the four corner points of the ego and following vehicles. To solve the problem of the intermediate connection point selection under unusual conditions and broader applicability in special emergency, a method is investigated in this paper. The reference point us identified based on the location of obstacles, the collision risk point on the ego vehicle is then determined, and finally the intermediate connection point is calculated based on the vehicle size data. The simulation result validates the correctness of the intermediate connection point selection method.

articleTitle: Analysis of the impact of changes in grid operation mode on the short-circuit ratio of regional power grids
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the continuous transformation of the global energy structure, the penetration rate of a large number of new energy sources, represented by wind power and photovoltaic, is increasing, resulting in the power system gradually presenting a weak grid characteristic with low short-circuit ratio. As an important indicator for determining the strength of the grid, the short circuit ratio is usually positively correlated with the strength of the grid, and there are a series of instability problems such as wide frequency oscillation and transient overvoltage in the grid with low short circuit ratio. In this paper, the impact of grid operation mode changes on the short-circuit ratio of a regional power grid is investigated through the simulation calculation of a regional power grid.

articleTitle: Study on Fault Detection and Isolation Method for Traction Networks Based on Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Rapid fault diagnosis in the traction power supply system of heavy-haul railways is critical for maintaining the normal operation of railway transportation. To address this challenge, this paper presents a novel short-circuit fault diagnosis method for traction networks, utilizing wavelet transform. The proposed method first applies wavelet transform to segment the fault intervals, followed by the decomposition and reconstruction of signal diagrams to accurately identify the specific faulted line. By meticulously analyzing the current signal variations caused by the fault, both the fault interval and the fault line can be precisely determined. Experimental results demonstrate that the wavelet-based approach significantly enhances the accuracy and efficiency of fault detection, thus validating the feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: Adaptive Seam Optimization in Image Stitching via Saliency-Based Weighting and Smoothness Constraints
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Image stitching plays a pivotal role in various computer vision applications. This paper proposes an adaptive seam optimization method to address issues such as misalignment, ghosting, and the loss of significant details in highly salient regions due to poor seam placement. Our approach integrates saliency-based weighting with smoothness constraints, dynamically adjusting the seam position to avoid cutting through visually important regions. Additionally, smoothness constraints evaluate color, texture, and edge differences between adjacent pixels, ensuring smooth transitions across seams. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, showing a significant reduction in ghosting and misalignment compared to classical and state-of-the-art stitching techniques. Our method excels particularly in highly salient regions and complex scenes, producing high-quality seamless panoramic images.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimization design of passenger car driver’s seat based on multi-criteria decision making approach
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Optimizing seat design is crucial for enhancing occupant safety in automotive crashes. In this study, the working conditions of automobile seats in both front and rear collisions were constructed, and their accuracy was verified through experimental tests. Building on this foundation, an innovative approach was introduced that combines optimized super-Latin experimental design with multi-criteria decision-making techniques. For the first time, a decision-making method for prioritizing the risk of failure modes in seat optimization was evaluated using regret theory and the COPRAS method. This comprehensive optimization approach led to significant improvements in seat design, including reductions in mass and cost by $\mathbf{7. 8 1 \%}$ and $\mathbf{3 3. 3 5 \%}$, respectively, an increase in the first-order modal frequency to 23.3 Hz, and a substantial enhancement in seat comfort. These findings underscore the significant and innovative contributions of this study to advancing seat safety and comfort.

articleTitle: Circuit design based on RAM/ROM semiconductor memory circuits
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The memory circuit is an important part of the composition of digital systems. Due to the composition of the memory structure, the memory can not only realize the function of storage but also can realize the combinational logic circuits, code conversion circuits, function generators, DDS signal source, etc., but the premise is that you need to write the data into the ROM/RAM first. Hence, the design of the ROM/RAM read/write circuits is especially critical. This paper carries out the design of memory read/write circuits and simulates the read/write circuits of 2K8RAM, based on which the schematic design of ROM/RAM constituting combinational logic circuits, code conversion circuits, and function generators is realized.

articleTitle: Highly Sensitive and Wide Linear Range Flexible Pressure Sensors with Hierarchical Microstructure and Its Application in Human Signal Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Flexible piezoresistive pressure sensors have been widely investigated for their potential applications in wearable medical devices. However, the low sensitivity and low detection range severely hamper their prospects in the above applications. In this paper, a flexible pressure sensor with high sensitivity and wide linear range was prepared using hierarchical microstructure carbon nanotubes/PDMS composite. The sensors’ preparation, pressure sensing mechanism, and sensing performance were investigated. The results show that the pressure sensor has a high sensitivity ($12.3 \mathrm{kPa}^{-1}$), a wide linear sensing range ($0-200 \mathrm{kPa}$), a fast response recovery time (83 ms), and a low minimum limit of detection ($\mathbf{5 0} \mathbf{~ P a}$). Application demonstrations of pulse monitoring show that the sensor is expected to be used in areas such as human medical and health detection.

articleTitle: A Continual Learning Method for Facial Recognition Task
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Most existing continual learning algorithms are applied to easy recognition tasks with smaller spans. In view of this, this paper attempts to apply continual learning algorithm to face recognition tasks with larger spans and higher difficulty, and analyze the performance of the algorithms on this type of task. In order to meet the demand for lightweight models in production, a new continual learning strategy involving the SqueezeNet, which has the same accuracy as AlexNet but 50 times smaller model parameters, with the Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC), that is a regularization continual learning method with the least impact on model size is proposed. Based on this, the paper further explores the relationship between the difficulty of learning tasks and the learning order within the framework of continual learning. The experiments show that under the learning order of learning difficult tasks first and then learning easy tasks, the proposed method retained $16.1 \%$ and $11 \%$ more knowledge than typical deep learning models. Therefore, the proposed model is more suitable for facial recognition scenarios where difficult tasks are learned first and easy tasks are learned later, and can effectively avoid catastrophic forgetting problems in this scenario.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Configuration of Urban Substation Charging Station Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the deepening of the “dual carbon” policy, the electric vehicle industry, as an important way to replace fossil fuels, has developed rapidly in recent years and become a focus of attention in multiple industries such as electricity, transportation, and chemical engineering. Electric vehicle fast charging stations occupy an important position in the public charging market due to their efficient and fast charging characteristics. However, the high randomness and rapidly increasing charging load brought by fast charging stations pose serious challenges to the safe and stable operation of the power grid. This study proposes an optimized operational configuration method for typical fast charging stations for electric vehicles based on DQN (Deep Q-Network) algorithm, and specifically introduces the content of substation charging configuration. This study aims to optimize the capacity of each charging station based on economic and operational efficiency by analyzing the output characteristics of distributed power sources within the station and the charging behavior patterns of electric vehicles, and to construct a typical fast charging station optimization operation configuration model. This model is not only constrained by key factors such as power balance within the station and distributed power output, but also considers optimization of substation charging configuration to ensure efficient operation of charging stations and stability of the power grid. By using DQN algorithm instead of traditional genetic optimization algorithm to solve the optimal solution of the model, this study achieved refined management of charging station configuration. Finally, through empirical analysis of various configuration examples, the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method were verified, providing a new technical path and decision support for the optimized operation of urban fast charging stations.

articleTitle: Study on the Insulation Aging Performance of Dry-Type Bushing Resin-Impregnated Paper Capacitor Cores
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The main insulation component of dry-type bushings' capacitor cores is constructed from crepe paper impregnated with epoxy resin under high temperatures. During actual operation, thermal stresses can degrade the performance of epoxy insulation materials, and the resulting aging issues have become a significant factor affecting the stable operation of electrical equipment. To elucidate the impact of thermal aging on the epoxy resin in impregnated paper bushings, this study employs a sample preparation platform and thermal aging experimental setup to obtain epoxy resin and epoxy-impregnated paper specimens. Thermal aging experiments are conducted, with periodic assessments of mass loss and infrared spectroscopy of the aged samples. Results indicate that specimens experience rapid mass loss over 24-48 hours, while mass loss increases linearly from 48 to 288 hours. Infrared spectroscopy results reveal that the functional groups on the surface of the epoxy insulation material undergo corresponding changes, leading to significant alterations in the peak values of the absorption spectra.

articleTitle: Structural Design and Analysis of a Throwable Robot with Hybrid Rigid-Flexible Deformable Wheels
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Throwable robots, which can be rapidly deployed into operational areas through manual throwing, catapulting, or aerial dropping, hold significant potential for applications in military reconnaissance, urban counter-terrorism, and postdisaster rescue due to their compact size, light weight, and high portability. However, most existing throwable robots have limitations in terms of size and impact resistance, which prevents them from adapting to special terrains such as stairs and mountains, severely reducing their mobility efficiency and reliability. To address these issues, this paper innovatively proposes a tossing robot capable of climbing stairs. First, the overall structure of the robot was designed using 3D modeling software, combining a flexible wheel with a deformable wheel to ensure sufficient impact resistance while enhancing obstaclecrossing capabilities. A telescopic tail support was also designed to prevent direct impact during tossing. Subsequently, a physical prototype of the throwable robot was manufactured based on the 3D model, and the overall control system and PID control algorithm for the robot were designed. The robot’s mobility and obstacle-crossing performance were tested, including the deployment of the deformable wheel and the wheel’s obstaclecrossing test. The tests demonstrated the robot’s good flexibility and obstacle-crossing ability.

articleTitle: Design of a Data Distribution System for High Earth Orbit Satellites
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In response to the demand of meteorological applications for high orbit satellite data distribution systems, a high orbit S-band downlink broadcast link system based on spread spectrum system is proposed through analysis and design of communication frequency band, link budget, communication system, user capacity, and anti-interference ability. This system has the advantages of strong anti-interference ability and low terminal power consumption. This study has reference significance for the design and deployment of data distribution systems for civil high orbit meteorological satellite.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Accurate Control of Asynchronous Motor Rotation Angle based on SINAMIC S120
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In conventional drilling operation, toolface drifting will be easily happened when adopting down-hole-bend deflecting motor in steering drilling section, and it can trigger some problems such as control failure in borehole trajectory. For this problem, a dynamic control method for the down-hole directional motor toolface is needed urgently. This paper develops an accurate control method for the rotation angle of asynchronous motor. The method which adopts Fuzzy control combined with vector control technology for accurate positioning control is analyzed through MATLAB/Simulink, and tested at SINAMIC S120. The simulation and experimental results show that the control algorithm presented in this paper can achieve the accurate positioning of motors, and the control system has high control accuracy, fast dynamic response characteristics. Top drive system or rotary table combined with this kind of motor lays a solid foundation for achieve the accurate control over the down-hole-motor toolface at the well site.

articleTitle: A UAV Detection and Countermeasures Strategy Evaluation System Based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) technology, easy-to-control, lowcost consumer and industrial UAVs have been widely used, accompanied by various “black flying” phenomena that also pose a serious threat to public safety and national security, there is an urgent need for effective technical means to supervise UAV. Because of the limitations of the existing evaluation system of UAV detection and countermeasures strategies, this paper takes the application of various UAV detection and countermeasures strategies in the security conditions of major cities as the background, from preliminary targeting capability, public opinion guidance, detection accuracy, economic cost, effective range, time cost. By analyzing the specific situation model of security in various cities, the analytic hierarchy process is used to design the judgment matrix and the target matrix, and the APP Designer tool of MATLAB is used to design the visual program. Finally, a software platform for intelligent and visual UAV detection and countermeasure strategy evaluation system based on the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) is built, which provides a theoretical reference for the detection and countermeasure of security UAVs in various cities.

articleTitle: TCAD modeling of 3D 4H-SiC MOSFET and simulation of heat distribution during power cycling
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: In this study, a viable solution of the modeling of a three-dimensional SiC MOSFET with flexible parameter settings was proposed. Based on the finite element simulation, a reliable simulation of power cycling was built using the Sentaurus TCAD. Considering the Hydrodynamic for carriers, the incomplete ionization model for the heavy doping and other factors, the optimizations on physical models and convergence are conducted. In particular, an adaptive method of meshing is achieved to endow the simulation with less solving time and more accuracy. The proposed method can provide the visualization of the heat distribution inside the device. The above results can be helpful for the analysis of device failure after power cycling, which can provide a basis for the development of the SiC MOSFETs.

articleTitle: The TGDouble-UNet Network for Polyp Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Accurate segmentation of polyps in colorectal endoscopic images enables the early detection of potential precancerous lesions in the colon and rectum. However, the similarity in texture and color between polyps and the background poses a significant challenge to precise segmentation. To improve the accuracy of polyp segmentation in colorectal endoscopic images, this paper proposes the TGDouble-UNet network model, which features a cascaded encoder-decoder architecture. To address the limitation of traditional CNN encoders, which focus only on local image features, a TG Block module composed of group convolution and Transformer is proposed. This allows the model to capture both global and local features of the polyps. To alleviate the issue of inaccurate decoding caused by information loss during the encoding process, the BranchUnet structure is introduced to extract second-level encoded features. Finally, the polyp segmentation result is obtained by combining the encoded features from both levels. To validate the effectiveness and advancements of the model, quantitative and result visualization experiments were conducted on the publicly available datasets CVC-ClinicDB and Kvasir-SEG. The experimental results show that the proposed TGDouble-UNet model achieved a Dice coefficient of 0.9267 and a mIoU of 0.8727 on CVC-ClinicDB, and a Dice coefficient of 0.9199 and an mIoU of 0.8647 on Kvasir-SEG. Compared to the currently well-performing Double-UNet, the TGDouble-UNet improved the Dice and mIoU by 0.28% and $\mathbf{1. 1 6 \%}$ on CVC-ClinicDB, and by $\mathbf{1. 3 5 \%}$ for both Dice and mIoU on Kvasir-SEG.

articleTitle: Research of Garbage Cleaning Robot Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the development of neural networks and deep learning, computer vision recognition technology has been widely applied. At present, the labor cost in the field of social cleanliness is constantly increasing, especially in some harsh working environments, and timely completion of garbage cleaning and disposal has become a difficult task. Automated garbage cleaning through robots is the most effective way to solve this problem. This design is based on Raspberry Pi for programming, using image recognition technology to accurately identify the types and locations of garbage, in order to reach the designated location for cleaning. Deep learning systems mainly focus on paper clusters, randomly classify the content in the image library according to sample and test sets, and continuously train convolutional neural network models to improve their performance. The experiment shows that this model can effectively and accurately identify paper waste and complete the grabbing process.

articleTitle: Research on short-circuit fault identification method of traction transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The short-circuit fault of traction transformer is very harmful. Aiming at the limitation of the existing second harmonic blocking principle, a differential protection algorithm of traction transformer based on fractal correlation dimension is proposed. The algorithm is sensitive to the important parameters of the nonlinear dynamic evolution characteristics of the transformer. The inrush current and the short-circuit fault current are effectively identified by the different fault dimension eigenvalues of the transformer under different working conditions. The simulation model of $V / x$ traction transformer and fractal protection algorithm is built, and the accuracy of the method is verified by uploading it to the real-time digital simulation platform RT-plus.

articleTitle: Online Microscopic Imaging Combined with Machine Learning Image Processing for Online Monitoring of Mineral Froth Flotation Process
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Froth flotation is an important process in the mineral processing industry for extracting valuable materials. This work investigates online microscopic imaging and machine learning based image analysis methods for real-time monitoring of the process. Previous limited work explored imaging the foam at the top surface layer of the froth flotation process. The new process imaging system in this work uses a corrosion-resistant online real-time imaging probe that can be put into the inside of the slurry and capture real-time images of bubbles. The acquired images are analyzed online using deep learning algorithms to automatically obtain key parameters of the bubbles, providing valuable data for froth flotation research and process control.

articleTitle: Finite element modeling and vibration reduction analysis of thin-walled structure with constraining layer damping
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Thin-walled structures are widely used in the engineering field, but due to their low stiffness and low damping, they are prone to vibration. The application of constrained layer damping (CLD) surface treatment can effectively improve the vibration suppression ability of thin-walled structures. This paper uses the carbon fiber composite plate as the research object of thin-walled structures and uses finite element method to model the cantilever plate with CLD. The composite element with four nodes and 28 degrees of freedom is used in the modeling. And the comparison of the frequency response and vibration mode obtained by the simulation method in this paper and the Nastran simulation software verifies the correctness of the modeling method. Finally, the optimized shape of the CLD is obtained based on the modal strain of the cantilever plate, verifying the rationality of the CLD configuration method.

articleTitle: SSENet: A Deep Neural Network Featuring Stacked Attention mechanism for Enhanced Bearing Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: This paper presents a deep learning network model, SSENet, tailored to address the performance degradation of bearing fault diagnosis models due to significant data distribution variations across different operating conditions. SSENet innovatively incorporates two core modules: a dual-branch feature extraction module and a joint optimization module. The dual-branch feature extraction module comprises two distinct network architectures, each specialized in processing data from specific operating conditions to capture the unique characteristic information of each. Conversely, the joint optimization module integrates the loss functions of both branches to achieve global optimization, ensuring robust model performance across diverse environmental conditions. The model introduces a Squeeze-andExcitation (SE) module with regularization and incorporates a transformer block capable of extracting long-term dependency information. This design aims to bolster the model’s representational capacity by dynamically adjusting the significance of feature channels and effectively mitigating the risk of overfitting. Consequently, this architecture significantly enhances the SSENet model’s performance in bearing fault classification under complex and fluctuating operating conditions. Furthermore, we augmented the original vibration signal with the first percentile signal ‘q1’ and the third percentile signal ‘q3’ to extract additional useful features for signal classification, thereby further improving performance.

articleTitle: Modal parameters identification of micro motor rotor by sound
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The existing modal parameters identification data of motor rotors generally is obtained by vibration sensors. Due to the influence of the additional mass of vibration sensors, there are significant errors in measuring micro motors. A method for identifying modal parameters of micro motor rotors based on acoustic signals is proposed in this paper, and the noise is depressed. This method collects acoustic signals by tapping the micro motor rotor and uses short-term energy integration to process acoustic signals in order to depress noise. We first establishes the theoretical basis for applying short-term energy integration to modal identification, determines the relationship between the slope of the inverse integration curve and the damping ratio, and then conducts modal simulation analysis on multi degree of freedom vibration noise signals to verify the correctness of the method. Finally, a hammering test was conducted on the rotor of the micro motor, and the method was verified for modal parameter identification.

articleTitle: Effective Reduction of Torque Fluctuations in Arc Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: This paper addresses the challenge associated with arc permanent magnet synchronous motors (arc PMSM), particularly the issue of significant torque fluctuations caused by side-end forces and winding asymmetry. In order to address this situation, a method is proposed for modifying the phase sequence arrangement of the stator windings of the arc permanent magnet synchronous motor and for optimizing the shaping of the motor’s side ends. The method has been demonstrated to be effective, with a reduction in torque fluctuation from 9.07% to $\mathbf{3. 6 4 \%}$. During the research process, the specific approach to changing the phase sequence arrangement and the technical aspects of side-end shaping optimization were elucidated in detail, and the effectiveness and feasibility of the method were strongly substantiated through a comparative analysis of experimental data.

articleTitle: Collaborative Optimization Operation Strategy of Photovoltaic Community Leasing Energy Storage Based on Master-slave Game
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Along with the rapid development of user-side distributed power generation technology, it has become an important development trend to improve the reliability and economy of community energy use through the configuration of energy storage, and how to build a joint interaction mechanism of energy storage and user-side resource energy sharing has become a key direction of energy storage layout in the user side. Under the background of energy interconnection, this paper proposes a cooperative optimization operation strategy based on masterslave game for photovoltaic community leasing energy storage. Firstly, the overall operation framework of PV community leasing energy storage is introduced, and the functions of each interest subject are analyzed. Then, an optimization model is built for community integrated energy operator (ICEO), energy storage operator (ESO), and community load aggregator, respectively. The game relationship among the subjects is analyzed, and a master-multiple-slave game model is constructed with ICEO as the master and ESO and community load aggregator as the slaves. The simulation results show that the proposed method is conducive to the promotion of new energy consumption, effectively takes into account the interests of multiple subjects, and then realizes the win-win cooperation between PV community and energy storage.

articleTitle: A method for tomato leaf disease identification based on an improved ConvNeXt model
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: This paper describes a tomato leaf disease recognition method based on an improved ConvNeXt model. The method aims to improve the model’s ability to recognize key features and feature extraction performance by introducing the local attention mechanism (ELA) and PReLU activation function. The dataset used in the study contains images of 10 tomato pests and diseases from 40 plant leaf pest categories. The local attention mechanism enhances the model’s ability to capture local features, while the PReLU activation function helps to solve the gradient vanishing problem and avoid neuron death. The experimental results show that the model achieves a high accuracy of ${9 9. 3 1 \%}$ on the tomato leaf disease classification task, which is significantly better than the traditional methods, and can effectively deal with the challenges of complex background interference and subtle and variable disease features. This research result is of great practical value for improving tomato disease identification and ensuring high yield and quality of tomato.

articleTitle: Analysis of signal strength characteristics based on typical operation site of power grid
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Following the continuous development of communication technology, under the background of smart power construction, in order to further meet the needs of communication, panoramic monitoring and security management of on-site personnel in power grid emergency operations, the key technologies of multi-frequency and multi-modal fusion communication are studied by analyzing the coverage of strong and weak signals in typical power grid application scenarios, and a portable multi-network fusion signal enhancement terminal device is developed. Realize multi-band signal sharing and interworking, support the field video terminal to switch between different operators’ signals, covering various typical operation scenarios. The results show that under the application of HD AF MIMO wireless relay transmission technology, SINR and other performance indicators are improved, the wireless relay gain efficiency can be increased by about 10 dB, the signal coverage distance in the operation blind area is significantly enhanced, the voice interaction quality is significantly improved, the video transmission is smooth, and the communication quality is significantly improved. Therefore, in the typical operation site of the power grid, the device can effectively realize the dynamic spectrum allocation of the three networks and the integration and flexible coverage of $4-5 \mathrm{G}$ signals, and solve the problem of emergency intelligent management of the grid operation signal blind area.

articleTitle: Rapidly-exploring Random Tree Based on Improved Sampling Space and Path Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Path planning is key to guiding the motion of robotic arms. Aiming at the randomness in sampling and the lack of smoothness in trajectories of Rapidly-exploring Random Tree (RRT) class algorithms, this paper first proposes a method that extends the line between new nodes and target points to determine a cuboid sampling space; Secondly, the obtained path is improved based on obstacle detection between odd-numbered nodes to see whether to remove intermediate branches, making the path smoother. The improved sampling and path processing methods proposed are applied to the RRT and RRT* algorithms, and respectively named as IRRT and IRRT* algorithms. Finally, the Matlab is used to simulate the proposed algorithm. The result verified the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on the Servo System based on DBO-BPPID Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Aiming at the requirements of high precision, strong robustness, and strong anti-disturbance ability of the anti-aircraft gun servo system, as well as the problems of internal parameter perturbation and external shooting torque interference, a BP neural network tuning PID control method based on the Dung Beetle Optimizer (DBO) is proposed. Firstly, the mathematical model of the artillery servo system is established, and the PID controller model is designed accordingly. Secondly, a BP neural network is added. A BP neural network can adjust PID parameters online through adaptive learning. However, the initial weights of the BP neural network are randomly selected, which makes it easy to fall into the local optimum during weight parameter training and affects the control performance of the system. Therefore, the DBO optimization algorithm is introduced to optimize the initial weights of the BP neural network by using DBO’s good global search ability, so as to speed up network convergence and improve the control performance of the system. Finally, the simulation results show that the DBO-BP-PID control algorithm designed in this paper can well meet the control requirements of the artillery servo system and has a good application prospect in the field of intelligent artillery servo control.

articleTitle: Keyword Extraction and Word Cloud Generation for Electricity Work Order Text Based on Attention Mechanism and TF-IDF Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: With the digital transformation of the power industry, the accumulation of a large amount of work order text data provides a rich information resource for enterprises. However, how to effectively extract key information from these texts remains a challenge. In this paper, we propose a keyword extraction method for electric power work order text that combines the attention mechanism and the TF-IDF algorithm, and visualize the importance of the keywords using word cloud technology. The method first removes noise through text preprocessing, and then calculates the importance of each word using the TF-IDF algorithm, while using the attention mechanism to learn the correlation between words in order to further optimize the selection of keywords. The experimental results show that the proposed method significantly improves the accuracy of keyword extraction compared to the traditional TFIDF algorithm. In addition, the generated word cloud can clearly highlight the core topics in the text, which helps the electric power enterprises to quickly identify and respond to customer needs, and improve work efficiency and service quality. The research results in this paper can provide an effective method for text data analysis in the electric power industry.

articleTitle: Design and control of a cable winding device for controlled tension loading
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Cable winding devices are becoming increasingly widely used in aerospace applications. In this study, a cable winding device consisting of a pulley set, a tension sen sor assembly, a buffer assembly, and a winch assembly is designed. The controlled tension loading of cables is achieved by combining cable winding devices with a controlled tension control system, which enables the loading of autonomously controllable tension on cables, equivalent to adding load to cables to simulate some special scenarios. The cable winding device realizes the real-time measurement of the cable tension through the tension-measuring component, and the stability of the tension-measuring component under the maximum load is investigated through finite element simulation of key components. In this paper, based on the design of the controlled tension control system, the experimental platform of the controlled tension control system is built. Firstly, the real-time loaded tension is regulated by feedback using the PID algorithm as the control strategy. Then, the optimal PID control parameters are found through Simulink simulation, and feed-forward compensation control is introduced. Finally, controllable tension loading experiments are conducted on the cables to verify the performance and stability of the system.

articleTitle: Design and experimental study of integrated multidimensional force measuring tool-holder
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: INTRODUCTION: In view of the force testing process in milling, this paper proposes a multi-dimensional force testing tool-holder based on HSK 63A tool holder, beam force sensor and strain gauge bridge. METHODS: In response to the structural stifness of the force measuring tool-holder, simulation driven optimization was carried out. On this basis, the construction of the force measuring tool-holder detection platform was completed. Finally, this article conducted experimental research on static calibration and dynamic testing of the force measuring tool holder. RESULTS: The results show that compared with the reference force measuring instrument, the measurement errors of axial force, radial resultant force, and torque are controlled within $9.5 \%, 8.7 \%$, and 6.7%, respectively.

articleTitle: Fault propagation influence analysis method combining improved ASP and DWNodeRank
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of fault propagation influence analysis, an improved fault propagation influence analysis method combining ASP and DWNodeRank algorithm is proposed based on the analysis of the influencing factors of fault propagation. In order to reflect the difference of fault propagation probability between units, the weight of directed edge in the network is used to replace the information propagation rate in ASP index; Because DWNodeRank algorithm only considers the influence between adjacent nodes, it is improved by calculating the importance influence of third-order neighborhood nodes according to the third-order influence principle; Aiming at the problem that neither of the two algorithms can fully consider the influencing factors of fault propagation, combined with their advantages, a fusion improved algorithm is proposed. Taking NC machining center as an example, it shows that the fusion improved algorithm is more suitable for fault propagation influence analysis.

articleTitle: Active protection method of single-phase fault for distribution network considering fault ride-through of distributed generator
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The impact of single-phase grounding faults in distribution networks on equipment and personal safety is becoming increasingly severe. However, due to the limited short-circuit current from distributed generation sources, controlled fault behavior, and the coupling of output characteristics, the fault processes in distribution networks exhibit polymorphic behavior, which may further reduce the accuracy of single-phase fault protection in neutral point ungrounded systems. To address this, a protection method for single-phase grounding faults in distribution networks is proposed, based on the adaptive injection of additional characteristic signals from distributed generation sources. Considering the low voltage ride-through requirements for distributed generation, an adaptive characteristic frequency current injection strategy is introduced. The distribution of characteristic frequency currents in the distribution network is analyzed, focusing on the amplitude and phase characteristics of these currents in the feeders. An active protection method for single-phase faults in distribution networks based on characteristic frequency currents is proposed, and the correctness of this method is validated through simulations.

articleTitle: Design of an Arm Posture Recognition System and Adaptive TENS Therapeutic Device Based on sEMG Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: This study presents the design of a novel arm posture recognition and adaptive transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation (TENS) physiotherapeutic device utilizing surface electromyographic (EMG) signals. The system employs high-precision EMG sensors for real-time monitoring of users' arm EMG signals, alongside sophisticated signal processing algorithms to facilitate posture recognition. Unlike conventional physiotherapy methods, this innovative design incorporates an adaptive adjustment feature that dynamically modulates the electrical stimulation intensity and frequency based on the user's myoelectric feedback, thereby optimizing therapeutic efficacy. Furthermore, it integrates lightweight algorithmic deployment of embedded artificial intelligence, enhancing its usability. This system holds significant potential for application in rehabilitation medicine, sports medicine, and geriatric care, with the aim of improving treatment precision and comfort while aiding in the restoration and maintenance of arm functionality.

articleTitle: An Improved Genetic Algorithm for Bi-objective Dynamic Orienteering Problem with Time Windows
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: This paper proposes an Improved Genetic Algorithm combined with Path-Reconstruction operators (IGAPR) to solve the Dynamic Orienteering Problem with Time Windows (DOPTW). In this problem, task nodes appear dynamically, challenging the solution strategies of traditional orienteering problems. We divide the entire planning horizon into multiple static time periods and apply a heuristic genetic algorithm within each period to generate high-quality solutions. Experimental results on modified Solomon and Cordeau benchmark instances demonstrate that our approach outperforms traditional greedy algorithms and conventional genetic algorithms in terms of path rewards and fitness value. Additionally, the paths generated by our method adapt to dynamic changes and exhibit good scalability as the number of nodes increases.

Author Keywords: Dynamic Orienteering Problem with Time Windows

articleTitle: Research on identification method of heavy-duty vehicle’s SCR system status based on SVM
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: The emission control of heavy-duty vehicles will be seriously affected by abnormal working state of SCR system. This has adverse effects on environmental pollution and human health. Based on the remote supervision data of heavy-duty vehicle, the identification method of heavy-duty vehicle’s SCR system status based on SVM are studied in this paper. On-line remote and accurate identification of urea consumption status in SCR system of heavy-duty vehicles can be achieved. Thus supporting problem vehicle screening and protecting the green environment. Firstly, the obtaining method of urea consumption segments based on urea level identification is proposed. Then, four feature parameters, including urea level change, urea-fuel ratio, ureanitric ratio and urea-distance ratio, are introduced to quantify urea consumption level in SCR system. Finally, a SVM-based heavy-duty vehicle’s SCR system status identification method is proposed. The accurate identification of SCR system state of heavy-duty vehicle is realized.

articleTitle: Research on Carbon Footprint Analysis Method of A-Class Single-Phase Cost-Controlled Intelligent Energy Meter Product
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electrical, Mechanical and Computer Engineering (ICEMCE)
abstract: Facing with upward pressure on carbon emissions from the electric sector, China’s governments promote carbon reduction of electrical equipment manufacturing industry. This manuscript analyzed the production process of watt-hour meters. Using life cycle assessment technology, the environmental impact of Type A single-phase smart prepaid meters was quantified, covering several key stages of the product life cycle (including raw material collection, manufacturing, logistics and operation).
